questions.question:
D10 — TODO proposal: record a deferred TODOS.md item to evaluate a real body typeface for the settings shell (replacing system-ui) in a later design pass?
Project/branch/task: main, /plan-design-review of PLAN.md, post-pass TODOS.md updates.
ELI10: DESIGN.md and this plan keep system-ui as the app font, and you excluded visual exploration from this update, so nothing changes now. The only design-debt item left is that system-ui is the one AI-slop signal the review flagged: it is the default stack, not a chosen voice. This question is only about whether to write that down in TODOS.md so a future /design-consultation picks it up, not about changing anything here. What: evaluate one role-scoped sans (for example DM Sans, Instrument Sans, IBM Plex Sans) for the settings shell and controls. Why: a chosen typeface is the cheapest tell that the app was designed rather than assembled. Pros: brand voice across the whole app. Cons: touches every screen, needs a font-loading strategy and a DESIGN.md revision; not a settings-page task. Depends on: a DESIGN.md update via /design-consultation. Principle: subtraction default says do not add it now; the TODO just keeps the debt visible.
Stakes if we pick wrong: either the debt is forgotten, or a note lands in TODOS.md that you consider noise.
Recommendation: A because the debt is real but explicitly out of scope, and a written TODO costs nothing.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Net: keep the typography debt visible vs. drop it.

options.label: A Add to TODOS.md (recommended)
options.description: ✅ The one remaining design-debt item stays visible for the next /design-consultation run (human: ~5min / CC: ~1min to record). ✅ Nothing changes in this update; DESIGN.md and system-ui stay as approved. ❌ Adds a TODOS.md file to a repo that does not have one yet (written after plan mode ends).

options.label: B Skip, not valuable enough
options.description: ✅ No TODOS.md noise; system-ui is a deliberate design-system choice. ✅ Zero follow-up work. ❌ The typography debt is not recorded anywhere and may be re-discovered later.

options.label: C Build it now in this PR
options.description: ✅ Removes the slop signal immediately across the settings page. ✅ Fonts load with the existing shell. ❌ Directly contradicts the plan's "no visual exploration" and DESIGN.md's system-ui rule; app-wide scope in a settings-page PR.
